test_row_tuple: test the DataFrame.row() method to return a single row by index or by predicate, with named and error handling cases
test_rows: test the DataFrame.rows() method to return all rows as tuples or named dictionaries, including null columns
test_rows_by_key: test the DataFrame.rows_by_key() method to group rows by key column(s) into a dictionary with tuple or named row values
test_iter_rows: test the DataFrame.iter_rows() method to iterate over rows as tuples or named dictionaries with configurable buffer size
test_row_constructor_schema: test DataFrame construction from row-oriented data with explicit schema types including integer and unsigned integer types
